title: You Recite Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleep. Its Only Twin Verse Holds a Corpse.
excerpt: The word 'throne' (kursi) appears exactly twice in the Quran: God's throne that holds the cosmos without tiring (2:255), and Sulaymān's throne with a lifeless body cast upon it (38:34). And the verse's rarest words — drowsiness, burden, severance — are each used once in the whole Book.
seo_title: Ayat al-Kursi: Its Only Twin Throne Holds a Body
seo_description: The word kursi (throne) appears exactly twice in the Quran — God's throne over the cosmos and Sulaymān's throne with a body cast on it. A close reading of Ayat al-Kursi's rarest words.
